history.text: Tswana chiefdoms consolidated across the Kalahari margins.
Britain declared the Bechuanaland Protectorate at the chiefs' request.
Independence came on 30 September, with Seretse Khama as first president.
Diamonds were found at Orapa, transforming the economy.
Sustained growth made Botswana one of Africa's stronger middle-income economies.

worthSeeing.title: Okavango Delta:
worthSeeing.text: An inland delta that floods the Kalahari each year, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Chobe National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Known for one of the largest elephant populations in Africa.

worthSeeing.title: Makgadikgadi Pans:
worthSeeing.text: Vast salt flats, remnants of a prehistoric lake, east of Maun.
